# openprovider_ssl_orders (Data Source)

Lists the SSL orders of the account, with their status and expiration date, so a configuration can find an existing order or warn about one that expires.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Every order of the account.
data "openprovider_ssl_orders" "all" {}

# The active orders for one common name.
data "openprovider_ssl_orders" "www" {
  common_name = "www.example.com"
  status      = ["ACT"]
}

output "expiration_dates" {
  value = { for order in data.openprovider_ssl_orders.all.orders : order.id => order.expiration_date }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `common_name` (String) Only list the orders with exactly this common name.
- `status` (List of String) Only list the orders with one of these statuses (for example `ACT`).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `all`, or the common name when `common_name` is set.
- `orders` (Attributes List) The orders of the account. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--orders))

<a id="nestedatt--orders"></a>
### Nested Schema for `orders`

Read-Only:

- `active_date` (String) When the certificate became active.
- `autorenew` (Boolean) Whether the order renews automatically.
- `brand_name` (String) The brand of the certificate.
- `common_name` (String) The common name of the certificate.
- `expiration_date` (String) When the certificate expires.
- `id` (Number) The SSL order identifier, as `openprovider_ssl_order` imports it.
- `order_date` (String) When the order was placed.
- `product_id` (Number) The SSL product of the order.
- `status` (String) The status of the order.
